result.title: Continuous Foundation-Guided Pseudo-Label Weighting for Breast Ultrasound Domain Adaptation
result.summary: Breast ultrasound segmentation models often generalize poorly across scanners, institutions, and patient populations. We investigate continuous foundation-guided pseudo-label weighting for unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA). An exponential-moving-average (EMA) teacher generates target-domain pseudo-labels, while a frozen ultrasound segmentation model (AutoSAMUS) modulates their contribution using a bounded weight that combines the prior's certainty with its probabilistic agreement with the teacher. In contrast to our earlier selective BiRP rule, the proposed formulation supervises every target pixel with a weight in [0.5, 1] and requires no foundation-model inference at test time. We evaluate the method on five public breast ultrasound datasets, spanning three source domains and eleven source-target directions. Under the TransUNet protocol, continuous weighting outperforms both all-pixel EMA and original BiRP on all four BUSI-source targets, and achieves the highest mean Dice and lowest HD95 among the compared methods on all four BUS-BRA-source targets. Results with BrEaST as the source are mixed: continuous weighting performs best on BUSI and comparably to original BiRP on OASBUD, whereas none of the adaptation methods surpasses source-only training on BUS-UCLM. In a separate U-Net pipeline, agreement-only weighting performs comparably to the full formulation, leaving the incremental value of prior certainty unresolved. Because the weighting rule was developed after some target-test results had been examined, we treat the study as exploratory and report adverse as well as favorable outcomes.

AI.brief_summary: 研究乳腺超声分割的无监督域适应：由 EMA 教师生成目标域伪标签，再用冻结的超声基础模型产生取值于 [0.5,1] 的有界连续权重（融合先验确定性与与教师概率的一致性）来加权监督每个像素，在五个公开数据集上作探索性评估并同时报告不利结果。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「确定性×一致性」的连续逐元素加权规则可能可供核查 latent 推理中对视觉证据或监督贡献做软加权（而非硬筛选）的做法，但原文本身聚焦分割域适应，不涉及推理期 latent 状态，迁移价值需自行判断。
